# mkfs.erofs --compress-hints for the EROFS payload inside each APEX:
# "<physical cluster size in bytes> <pattern>"; a size of 0 stores the
# matching files uncompressed. Init scripts and VINTF fragments are a few
# hundred bytes each and stay readable in the payload's bytes, which the
# target-files verifier searches for the example HALs' service definitions.
# The adb daemon stays readable the same way: the verifier looks in it for the
# launch properties that its p0011 topics read (the host application's key and
# the TCP policy), which a build without those topics would lack.
0 .*\.rc$
0 .*\.xml$
0 .*bin/adbd$
